messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — docs CI failed on my PR updating SDK snippets. markdown-link-check found a 404 on an external example, plus a small Vale warning.

tom: saw it. can we swap the external link to the canonical sdk host instead of the old examples domain? also vale flagged passive voice in the new paragraph.

elaine: paste the linkcheck output and i’ll craft a tiny patch.

docs-bot: [ci] docs-preview failed — linkcheck=1, spell=0, vale=1. details: https://ci.internal/reports/1943210000

maria: copying output:
```
Linkcheck report:
- https://examples.oldsdk.com/auth  -> 404 Not Found

Vale issues:
- docs/snippets/auth.md: passive-voice detected: "we will" (VALE/PassiveVoice)
```

tom: easy fix: change link to https://sdk.example.com/auth and reword "we will" -> "we'll" or rephrase to active voice. i can do it but i'm offline until ~2pm PT. @phil any chance you can eyeball later?

phil: i can review this evening. if it's link + tiny wording i'm fine to approve. plan: wait for green CI then merge in the evening merge window. :thumbsup:

elaine: one more nit — the code block header had an extra trailing space which md-lint complains about. i'll trim it in the patch.

maria: thanks. i'll open a tiny follow-up PR (fix link + vale + code-block whitespace) and mark it ready for review. linking the PR here once created.

deploy-bot: docs-preview job queued at 1943210200; rebuild will run after PR updates.

tom: FYI we could also add a short CDN redirect /examples/auth -> https://sdk.example.com/auth if we hit more 3rd-party links, but prefer updating docs for correctness.

maria: created PR 1943210300-maria-docs-fix-link (small changes). added changelog line: "fix external example link, adjust wording to active voice, trim code block header"

phil: noted — i'll review after dinner. if CI green and no other comments i'll approve.

maria: merging plan: wait for phil's review + green docs-preview. target merge time 20:00 UTC tonight. if not approved by then i'll ping SRE for exception or schedule next merge window.

tom: ack. thanks everyone.

phil: ack — will do.

maria: thanks team :heart:
